Same plan+QA+test-plan+prompt package as provider_correction, please.

validate_plan_package.py exits 0 against the output directory
plan_qa verdict line is well-formed and Findings are Critical/High only, no style/low-severity items
every test id in the prompt's TEST section matches the execution test plan's ids, and vice versa

plan is grounded in the real code: references runtime/controller.py's actual version-resolution mechanism and tests/check_meta_prompt.py's actual expectations, not a generic staleness description
